options.name: automount
options.description: Whether to perform auto mount of mountpoints inside guest disk image

options.name: command
options.description: List of commands to run directly from binaries, shell and command are mutually exclusive

options.name: mounts
options.description: List of mounts that will be attempted. Each element is a dictionary {'/path/to/device': '/path/to/mountpoint'}

options.name: network
options.description: Whether to enable network for appliance

options.name: selinux_relabel
options.description: Whether to perform SELinux context relabeling

options.name: shell
options.description: List of commands to run in shell (commands are invoked from /usr/bin/sh), shell and command are mutually exclusive
